title: lazylogcat configuration
description: Configuration file for lazylogcat. Used in ~/.config/lazylogcat/config.json (global), .lazylogcat/config.json (project), and .lazylogcat/config.local.json (local override). All fields are optional — layers are merged in order: defaults → global → project → local.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema file, for editor validation.

filter.description: Log filtering parameters. Each filter field accepts either a plain string or an object with a "value" field.

package_name.description: Android package name to filter logs by (e.g. "com.example.app").

log_text.description: Text content to search for in log lines.

text_filter.description: A filter value. Accepts a plain string (shorthand) or an object with a "value" field (extensible form).
